question.explanation: The source lists 16 known moons of Neptune: seven inner regular moons and nine irregular moons. Fourteen have names, while two have provisional designations.

quotes.Triton: The largest is Triton, discovered by William Lassell on 10 October 1846, 17 days after the discovery of Neptune itself.
quotes.Nereid: Nereid is the third-largest moon of Neptune.
